title: New Indian e-Passport Rollout 2026: Biometric Chip & Fast Airport Clearance
highlights: Contactless RFID chip embedded inside back cover for instant automated e-Gates at international airports
Old passports remain completely valid till expiry date - no panic renewal needed
Zero PSK appointment rejection when Aadhaar and 10th Marksheet details match 100%
summary: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) is now deploying next-generation e-Passports with embedded microchips storing biometric data for tamper-proof international travel.
content: The Government of India has accelerated the nationwide distribution of contactless e-Passports equipped with secure radio-frequency identification (RFID) microchips. These chips store the holder fingerprint biometrics, facial scan, and digital signature, making forgery virtually impossible. Existing passports remain 100% valid until their normal expiry date, but all new fresh and renewal applications through PSK are gradually being upgraded to the chip standard.

summary: Need urgent passport for international employment, medical emergency, or family travel? Learn Tatkaal document requirements and post-verification rules.
content: The Tatkaal Passport Scheme enables Indian citizens to receive an urgent passport dispatched within 1 to 3 working days without waiting for prior police verification. Police verification is conducted on a post-issuance basis. However, PSK verification officers demand strict compliance with 3 mandatory identity and address proofs, and name spellings must match without any ambiguity.

summary: Passport Seva Kendra holds up applications when name spelling differs between Aadhaar and 10th Marksheet. Here is how One & Same Person Annexure-D solves it.
content: One of the most frequent reasons for PSK appointment rejection or file hold is spelling variance between Aadhaar, PAN, and Matriculation (10th) marksheets (e.g. Mohd vs Mohammed, Ramzan vs Ramajan, or surname expansion). Under official Ministry guidelines, if the variation is phonetic or minor, an applicant can submit a Notarized One & Same Person Affidavit (Annexure-D) on non-judicial stamp paper without requiring an expensive official Gazette notification.

content: A valid and operational PAN Card is one of the primary KYC documents required by Passport Seva Kendra and banks. If your PAN card is inoperative due to lack of Aadhaar linking, or if your name spelling does not match Aadhaar, passport verification will trigger biometric discrepancies. We provide instant paperless e-PAN generation and correction services.

summary: Travelling abroad for work in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, or Europe? Here is the complete step-by-step procedure to get your PCC fast.
content: Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) is an official document issued by the Regional Passport Office certifying that an applicant has no criminal record in India. It is mandatory for long-term work visas, residency permits, and family immigration to GCC nations and European Schengen countries. You must hold an active Indian Passport to apply for a PCC.

highlights: Minor passports valid for 5 years or until attaining 18 years of age

summary: Applying for child passport (under 18 years)? Understand Annexure-C/D consent requirements when one parent is abroad or parents are separated.
content: Obtaining a passport for a minor child requires specific legal declarations by both parents. Under Indian Passport rules, minor passports are typically issued with 5-year validity or until the child reaches 18 years of age. If one parent is working overseas (e.g. in Gulf countries), their consent must be attested by the Indian Embassy or submitted via Annexure-C affidavit.
